queryOutcomes: Separate English and Simplified Chinese discovery queries were executed and recorded in the city record. They established local custodian/catalog evidence but did not identify a public Shulan cadastral viewer or anonymous parcel ID+geometry API.
requestOutcomes: The official Shulan homepage and Natural Resources Bureau catalog returned HTTP 200 over HTTP and were inspected with their current JavaScript/configuration. The catalog's public JSONP endpoints returned category IDs and 99 registration-document metadata records, including the local registration-center publisher, but no parcel geometry, safe native parcel ID, schema, CRS, or viewer route. A TLS-verified request to the Jilin provincial natural-resources site returned 200. The Shulan HTTPS host produced a TLS internal-alert failure; no certificate exception was authorized. An initial broad curl probe used -k while checking reachability; it was not used as evidence and is disclosed here for auditability. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, or unsafe field request was used.
